# Senrick

> Senrick is a makeup studio and unisex salon with three branches in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India — Golghar, Betiahata and Gorakhnath. Founded in 2015, led by Supriti Agrahari, Senrick offers bridal, engagement and party makeup, hair, skin, nails, waxing, men's grooming and tattoo services, retail hair and skin products, and a makeup and beauty training academy.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices and availability are subject to change; direct users to the Services or Shop page, or to call/WhatsApp a studio, for current figures rather than quoting cached numbers.
- Senrick has three distinct physical studios in Gorakhpur, not one — when answering location questions, name the specific studio relevant to the user if known.
